stubs.service: MySQL database (the MyFin API requires MySQL/MariaDB)
stubs.how: Dolt 2.7.3 (MySQL-wire-compatible, file-based, installed via mise as aqua:dolthub/dolt) runs locally from .ui-capture/db; the real Prisma migrations were applied to it unchanged. start.sh listens on PORT+2 (4421).
Placeholder SMTP_* values in .ui-capture/api-src/.env (localhost:2525). Nothing is called at startup; only the 'forgot password' flow would try to send mail, and it fails locally.

stubs.service: Rate limiter in the API (100 req/min per IP)
stubs.how: Not a stub: one-line patch in api-src/src/middlewares/rateLimiter.ts makes the limit overridable via RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE (start.sh sets 5000). All browser traffic reaches the API through the local proxy, i.e. from a single IP.

stubs.service: API session check for logged-out browsers (POST /validity)
stubs.how: Not a stub: small fix in api-src. Upstream crashed with HTTP 500 ('Cannot read properties of null (reading user_id)') when the web client sent its pre-login check with authusername 'undefined'. commonsController.checkAuthSessionValidity now treats unknown/missing users as 401, and userController.checkSessionValidity answers an invalid/absent session with 200 '0' (the client checks resp.data == '1' and redirects to /auth). 404 'no users yet' is unchanged.

notes: MyFin web (this repo) is a React/Vite SPA that needs the separate MyFin API (github.com/afaneca/myfin-api, Express + Prisma). The API source at main@fcbeacbe is vendored in .ui-capture/api-src (deps installed, Prisma client generated) and runs with two small patches (env-overridable rate limit; /validity no longer 500s for logged-out browsers), via `node --import tsx src/server.ts` on PORT+1 (4420). The front end was built with `VITE_MYFIN_BASE_API_URL=/api npm run build` and copied to .ui-capture/out. .ui-capture/serve.mjs serves out/ on PORT (4419) with SPA fallback and reverse-proxies /api/* to the API, so everything is same-origin. Runtimes are pinned in mise.toml (node 22.23.4 as in the Dockerfiles, dolt 2.7.3). Data: user 'marta' (Marta Oliveira, Lisbon, EUR) was created via POST /users and filled via the app's own backup import (PUT /user/restore) with .ui-capture/seed-backup.json, generated by gen-seed.mjs; seed.mjs then tags ~85 transactions through the regular PUT /trxs update. The DB in .ui-capture/db is already seeded; ./rebuild-db.sh recreates it from scratch (dolt init -> prisma migrate deploy -> start stack on a test port -> signup + restore + tagging). Other dev helpers: with-db.sh, test-start.sh, probe.sh. The data covers Jan 2025 to 17 Nov 2026: about 1,160 transactions (salary, meal card, mortgage capital transfers + interest, utilities, groceries, restaurants, subscriptions, trips to the Azores/Naples/Copenhagen, card payoffs, cash withdrawals, reimbursables, a few uncategorised recent imports), 11 accounts (checking, Revolut, savings, emergency fund, broker, meal card, wallet, credit card, mortgage, apartment value, one closed account), 29 categories (one inactive), 66 entities, 25 monthly budgets (Jan 2025 to Jan 2027; past months closed, Nov/Dec 2026 and Jan 2027 open, with breakdown items), 6 investment assets (ETFs, BTC, PPR, savings certificates, a fully sold P2P platform) with 75 investment transactions and monthly value snapshots, 5 goals (one archived), 12 import rules and 5 tags. Main areas after login: Dashboard, Transactions, Accounts, Budgets (list + detail + matrix), Categories/Entities/Tags, Rules, Investments, Goals, Stats (patrimony evolution & projections, category/entity evolution, year-by-year), Profile (theme, language, currency, backup).
